Refutation of Stop 1 field `refutation-target:` on comment 5750538063.

The dual-license is real. Leftover-pain fixtures do not tell the parent to halt after an uncited first all-accept. Followed as written, they post a bind map with honest cites and then a pain-audit critic. The halt licenses already on the tree are the thin-skill Mid-arc EXIT sentence, `evaluateHandoffPrint` on uncited Spec-path (the #4589 shape), leftover-split confirm, and Dual-stop halt-for-human. The proposed acceptance criterion that path-1 `missing-pain` / `unresolved-pain-audit` is not a conversation halt cannot bind as written.

## 1. Overbroad path-1 non-halt dual-licenses Handoff

blocks-the-design

Evidence. Pin SHA `0a97e9f6b5d2ce3d1737f4f6363302d34352d64e`. `evaluateAutoStampPath1Write` on Stop 1 ``pain: P1`` plus an uncited Spec-path lean refuses the path-1 write as `unrelieved-pain` (auto-stamp-path1 fixture, recorded as issue 4589). That same fixture expects `evaluateHandoffPrint` print true. `operatorVerbApplySet` with autoStamp and handoffApplies offers Handoff and Halt, not an empty menu. Field first maps 5746998760 (#4773), 5746998761 (#4774), 5746998777 (#4771), 5747028858 (#4772) are that shape: `yolo-standing: yes`, Spec-path, all-accept takes, no operative ``relieves`` / ``does-not-relieve`` / ``operator-deferred`` line. `evaluateYoloStandingLeftoverScope` never confirms a leftover split. Dual-stop spent plus unrelieved pain still prints halt-for-human or Handoff. #4772 first map already records Dual-stop cap 3 posts spent; reserved-slot in-cap needs asserted cites, which that map does not carry.

Failure mode. Publish AC 2 as written and a parent who follows Handoff waits on the widget while a parent who follows this issue continues into bind-plus-pain-audit. Same dual-license class as closed #4308, now against a live print predicate the contract already says must not go empty when autoStamp is true. A parent who treats leftover-recommend wait as a forbidden halt files leftover without a live confirm, posts incomplete deferred cite, or dishonest ``relieves``.

Disposition consequence. The lean cannot bind while AC 2 / Expected 3 call path-1 `missing-pain` a non-halt. Drop that sentence. Keep first-lean bind-capable honest cites (that is print-false on first ``relieves``). Keep parent-after-yolo pain-audit after `unresolved-pain-audit` while Dual-stop numbered or reserved slot remains. Leave leftover-split confirm, Handoff, and Dual-stop halt-for-human in place. Recut `evaluateHandoffPrint` only if the recovery path (first map already posted uncited, then a second bind map in the same unit) is still wanted; that recovery is the field shape and is Handoff today.

## 2. Leftover-pain fixtures do not license the halt

sharpens-framing

Evidence. `evaluatePainCitePlacement` allows cites on bind/retraction and forbids them on intermediate. `bindLeanPredecessorValid` requires a predecessor that does not already ``relieves`` those ids. Pain-audit dispatch is after the bind map. `evaluateYoloLeftoverRecommendation` recommends a leftover path when yolo plus uncited/does-not-relieve plus remainder; it does not EXIT the parent. Skill pin-read: motion-shape line 64 is confirm-then-bind/stamp; EXIT line 74 is operator fills the next envelope. "Live parent turns stay unenforced" is a fixture disclaimer, not a halt recipe.

Failure mode. Harvest that names leftover-pain.ts as the halt license recuts the wrong file and leaves Mid-arc EXIT plus Handoff print untouched. Root-cause item 3 reading of "do not auto-dispatch a pain-audit seat" as "wait for another operator turn" is the skill EXIT, not leftover-pain.

Disposition consequence. Record the hole as: under yolo standing, after an all-accept map that can carry honest cites, Mid-arc EXIT does not ask the operator to fill the next envelope. Parent after the already-standing yolo verb posts bind-capable cites if missing, then fills the pain-audit brief. Pointer-only in the thin skill. Do not mechanize leftover-pain parent turns (AC 4 already says that).

## 3. Named intermediate reason has no closed form

sharpens-framing

Evidence. Expected 2 makes the first all-accept bind-capable unless the parent records a named intermediate reason. No line-start, no fixture. Field maps already named residual English "until bind plus pain-audit" and ``audit:pain-P1`` substantiation; coverage still saw uncited. That substantiation token is not a pain cite.

Failure mode. Parent writes "this is intermediate" and next-envelopes again. Same hole. Forcing cites before leftover confirm cannot emit a well-formed different-issue deferred cite: the leftover number comes only from parent issue-create after a live confirm, and yolo standing does not confirm the split.

Disposition consequence. Either first-lean-is-bind with no free-English hatch except leftover-recommend (already an operator wait), or a closed reason token consumed by a fixture. Do not add a prose hatch.

## 4. Pain-audit stays a later envelope

sharpens-framing

Injection/swarm lens: this target changes who may fill the next critic envelope without a new operator turn (authority, envelopes, shared thread state).

Evidence. Round-1 critic of original P1 is not a pain audit (auto-stamp-path1 fixture). English Pain-audit headings are not targeting. The envelope field is operative line-start audit-targets with ids or none. Ceiling for that seat is the bind map id. Skill forbids auto-dispatch. Dual-stop reserved slot is one in-cap pain-audit when asserted coverage exists and numbered cap is spent; a second extra post needs a raise (this issue non-goal).

Failure mode. Same-unit continuation collapses pain-audit into round-1, skips the operative audit-targets field, or skill-auto-dispatches. Path-1 stays `unresolved-pain-audit`. Or an N>=3 spent map (#4772) dispatches a fourth numbered post without reserved-slot cites.

Disposition consequence. Name continuation as parent-filled brief, new ceiling at the bind map, process-only, dest cwd-without-occupy, no ingest. Not round-1 reuse. Not skill auto-dispatch.

## Road-not-taken

Rejected "the existing yolo-confirm MUST NOT already forbids treating confirm as next-envelope, so this issue is invalid." Yolo-confirm is confirm only. Handoff is a different verb. Mid-arc EXIT is a different EXIT. The interrupt is real.

Steelman of a narrower bind: Expected 2 (honest cites on the first all-accept) plus an EXIT pointer that parent-after-yolo fills the pain-audit envelope. Flip condition: AC 2 drops `missing-pain` non-halt; leftover-split and Handoff / Dual-stop halt stay.

## 5. Pin and field re-check

footnote

Stop 1 cites of skill line 64, EXIT line 74, and leftover-pain "live parent turns stay unenforced" match the pin. The four field maps match the #4589 uncited Spec-path print. No #4811 comments after ceiling 5750538063.

Bind 5750661832 carries operative Spec-path wrapping, operative ``relieves: P1``, and `Supersedes 5750606339`. Map 5750606339 is Lean-shaped with operative ``relieves: P1``. That is the #4554 harvest-overlap fixture in `handoff.test.ts`: print true, `harvestRelievesOverlap: true`. metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

Under yolo standing, after an all-accept successor lean is posted, the parent conversation still stops and names bind / pain-audit as the next envelope. The operator has to ask why the parent stopped. This is the leftover of closed #4308 after pain coverage (#4496 / #4593) landed.

Measured this session on #4774 / #4773 / #4772 / #4771. Launching utterance: evaluate, label, and if valid arc yolo no ingest; use appropriate n; no need to ask. Follow-up: stay off master, this is no ingest.

## Expected

After same-round siblings are posted, with yolo standing already on the launching utterance:

1. Parent posts the successor lean (first-lean offer still posts).
2. If that map is total all-accept and Stop 1 named pain, that lean is the bind lean unless the parent records a named reason it is intermediate. Pain cites go on it. "Intermediate recuts carry none" does not default the first lean to uncited.
3. Yolo standing is the confirm conjunct. Path-1 still refuses missing-pain / unresolved-pain-audit. That refuse is not a conversation halt.
4. In the same unit of work the parent posts the bind-capable lean if the first lean was uncited, then dispatches the pain-audit critic (parent after the yolo verb; not skill auto-dispatch).
5. Footnote-only pain-audit: path-1 stamp in that unit. Harvest-changing sharpening: recut bind in that unit while Dual-stop remains.
6. Do not print next-envelope / wait for the operator to say continue. Do not treat skill Mid-arc EXIT as yolo-complete. Ingest stays a later `task issue:ingest`.

## Actual

Parent posted all-accept successor leans without `relieves: P1` (read as intermediate because "intermediate recuts carry none"):

- #4773 5746998760
- #4774 5746998761
- #4771 5746998777
- #4772 5747028858

Then ended the turn: next envelope is bind lean plus pain-audit, then synthesis. Operator had to ask why you stopped. Bind leans and pain-audits ran only after that prompt. #4773 / #4774 later reached ingest-ready. #4772 / #4771 later Dual-stop-halted on recut audits, which is a different cap, not this halt.

## Root cause

Closed #4308 published yolo as confirm of a posted all-accept map. It did not publish what the parent does when that confirm cannot path-1 stamp because Stop 1 pain is uncited. Three published sentences still license the halt:

1. Thin skill motion: "the parent posts the successor lean; the operator confirms or amends before bind or stamp." Yolo replaces confirm. Bind/stamp is still sequenced after an operator turn.
2. Thin skill EXIT: "Mid-arc EXIT: operator fills the brief template and dispatches the next envelope." After successor lean, that sentence is the same shape as critic EXIT after posting.
3. leftover-pain.ts and the contract: live parent turns stay unenforced; leftover-pain helpers are fixtures. "Do not auto-dispatch a pain-audit seat" is read as do not dispatch without another operator turn.

Contract already forbids the halt reading: Treat yolo-confirm as ingest, next-envelope, or chip hygiene beyond the existing auto-stamp remaining-set write. A parent that follows the skill EXIT and the unenforced leftover-pain fixtures will still next-envelope. A parent that follows that MUST NOT will continue. Both readings are licensed. That is the #4308 shape with pain coverage in the way of stamp.

The agent miss is real: successor leans omitted pain cites, so evaluateAutoStampPath1Write would return missing-pain, and the parent treated stamp-refuse as handback. The recurrence is the missing MUST that yolo standing plus named Stop 1 pain plus an all-accept first lean is one unit through bind-capable cites and pain-audit dispatch.

## Reproduction

1. Operator: arc yolo no-ingest on an open issue whose Stop 1 will record pain: P1. Do not ask.
2. Parent stamps mechanism-shaped, posts Stop 1 with pain: P1, dispatches round-1 critic, posts an all-accept successor lean with no relieves / operator-deferred cite.
3. Observe whether the same unit posts a bind-capable lean and a pain-audit critic, or ends with next-envelope / wait.

## Impact

Yolo is standing auto-pilot. A Stop 1 pain list is the common case after #4496. The parent that matches current skill EXIT waits. The operator has to recut in chat. Same interrupt class as #4308 field instance #4293.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Contract publishes that under yolo standing, an all-accept first successor lean on an arc whose Stop 1 named pain is bind-capable (pain cites) unless the parent records a named intermediate reason. "Intermediate recuts carry none" does not default that first lean to uncited.
- [ ] Contract publishes that path-1 missing-pain / unresolved-pain-audit after that lean is not a conversation halt: parent posts the bind-capable lean if needed and dispatches pain-audit in that unit. Yolo-confirm remains not ingest and not next-envelope.
- [ ] Thin skill EXIT / motion pointer names that continuation. It does not copy the rule body. Mid-arc EXIT after successor lean under yolo standing does not default to operator next-envelope.
- [ ] Content-contract tests lock those pointer strings. Live parent turns may stay unenforced as today; this is a recording-obligation hole, not a new runtime gate, unless a later story mechanizes leftover-pain parent turns.

## Non-goals

- Waiving pain coverage because yolo is standing (#4592 refuse stays).
- Auto-ingest.
- Auto-dispatch of critics from the skill with no parent after an operator verb.
- Mapping looks-good / proceed onto confirm.
- Reopening #4308 yolo-as-confirm of empty disagreement.
- Mechanizing Dual-stop raise. Recut pain-audit after the reserved slot stays a raise.

## Related

#4308 (closed: yolo confirm of all-accept). #4496 pain coverage. #4593 leftover-pain fixtures; live parent turns unenforced. #4592 path-1 refuse. Field: #4774 #4773 #4772 #4771 this session.
